variables.name: Displacement
variables.description: Total swept volume of all cylinders in the internal combustion engine, measured in cubic inches or cubic centimeters, a primary determinant of engine power output and fuel consumption.

variables.name: Mpg
variables.description: Fuel economy of the vehicle measured in miles per gallon, representing the inverse relationship between fuel consumption and distance traveled under standard driving conditions.

variables.name: Horsepower
variables.description: Peak brake horsepower of the engine, quantifying the maximum mechanical power output at the crankshaft, a key performance parameter influenced by displacement, compression ratio, and engine tuning.

variables.name: Weight
variables.description: Curb weight of the vehicle measured in pounds, representing the total mass of the vehicle including all standard equipment and fluids but excluding occupants and cargo, a primary factor governing inertial resistance and fuel consumption.

variables.name: Acceleration
variables.description: Time in seconds required for the vehicle to accelerate from rest to 60 miles per hour, an inverse indicator of the power-to-weight ratio reflecting the combined effect of engine output and vehicle mass.
